arguments.summary: A credential compromise originating from WS-FIN-042 (CORP\jsmith) led to a confirmed Golden Ticket attack. Initial access was achieved via a malicious phishing email that executed an encoded PowerShell script from Outlook, leading to a Cobalt Strike beacon. The attacker performed lateral movement via SMB and escalated privileges to compromise the krbtgt account, enabling the creation of forged Kerberos tickets. All Domain Admin accounts were assumed compromised, necessitating mass credential revocation and krbtgt password resets. Immediate containment included blocking C2 IPs, resetting user credentials, and hardening the affected host.

Full EPP scan initiated on WS-FIN-042; Dropper.Linux.Agent.F detected.
Credentials for CORP\jsmith reset; MFA token revoked and re-enrollment initiated.
Mass credential revocation executed for 15 Domain Admin accounts; krbtgt password reset twice.
Ansible playbook 'windows_workstation_hardening.yml' applied to WS-FIN-042.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Config {
    meta:
        description = "Detects embedded configuration from Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Team"
        license = "MIT"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $a = { 2e 72 63 64 2e 63 66 67 } // ".rcd.cfg"
        $b = "beacon" fullword ascii
        $c = "stage" fullword ascii
        $d = "jitter" fullword ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}

arguments.summary: A critical vulnerability alert was triggered by EDR on host 10.0.10.50. Investigation revealed no compromise on the initially flagged host. However, further analysis identified a compromised host at 10.0.5.14 (WS-FIN-042) exhibiting Cobalt Strike beaconing behavior. The compromise originated from a phishing email that led to malicious PowerShell execution from Outlook, resulting in DLL sideloading via rundll32.exe. The attacker established C2 communication over HTTPS, modified the host file, and attempted lateral movement via SMB. The affected host is in the Finance department and is classified as high criticality.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dll {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common Cobalt Strike beacon DLL patterns"
        author = "SOC Team"
        tlp = "amber"
        malware_type = "RAT"
        attack_id = "T1071.001"
    strings:
        $a = { 6A 00 68 [2-4] 00 00 00 68 [2-4] 00 00 00 6A 00 E8 } // common beacon call pattern
        $b = "beacon.dll" fullword ascii
        $c = "HttpSendRequest" fullword ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
